en: An old monochrome postcard-style image showing a panoramic view over a wide inlet of water with many boats and dense urban buildings along the shores. In the foreground there is a hillside Turkish cemetery with tall, narrow Ottoman-style gravestones among trees. The waterway is the Golden Horn with the city of Constantinople in the distance. Printed French text at the top identifies the scene, and there is also a website watermark at the bottom.
